title: Three Nights and One Short Horn
subtitle: 音乐之声 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 音乐之声（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·音乐与表演）
meta: 主题语境：音乐之声（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·音乐与表演）　|　核心词汇：jazz　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 jazz 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the player ① played the jazz that no neighbour in the stage would have recorded, and he said the playing was the whole of the Friday. The ② jazz, meaning the music itself and not the horn, ran three Fridays and stayed unrecorded in the book; jazz, he said, is the only thing in a stage that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ kind of jazz in that stage had the same short horn beside it, and the ④ jazz at the far piano, meaning the tune they kept for the children to hum and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Jazz, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the player said the recording is the part that fills three Fridays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the jazz was the whole of the matter, meaning the freedom and not the music. The ⑥ jazz, meaning the freedom and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; jazz, he said, is either something you play or the only word that means both music and a freedom. He said the freedom is the part they remember.

By 1983 the ⑦ jazz had become a line in a disc, and the disc had become an argument about the short horn. The ⑧ jazz of the whole thing, the player wrote in July, was one stage and three Fridays of recording; jazz, he said, is either the tune at the far piano or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ jazz I remember is the jazz recorded in the disc, which closed in 1985 and is still recorded as the quietest in the stage. ⑩ Jazz, my mother said in 1987, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all jazz, she said, is a freedom that has agreed to look like music. She said the freedom was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 爵士乐（指舞台里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 爵士乐（指那段曲调本身，与铜管相对）
C. 固定搭配：play the jazz 演奏这段爵士乐
D. n. 爵士乐（指留给孩子们哼的那一支那一段）
E. n. 演奏之事（抽象总称，指一处舞台的爵士乐之事）
F. n. 爵士乐（指唱片里写到、被录下的的那一段）
G. n. 自由、即兴（指一件事里人人都听却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 即兴（抽象总称，指人人都听却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: played the jazz that no neighbour in the stage would have recorded
The jazz, meaning the music itself and not the horn
Every kind of jazz in that stage
the jazz at the far piano
the jazz was the whole of the matter
the jazz had become a line in a disc
The jazz of the whole thing

answers.why: play the jazz 意为“演奏这段爵士乐”，1978 年那位乐手把舞台里没有一位邻居肯录制的一段爵士乐做了一遍。
jazz 意为“爵士乐”，指那段曲调本身而不是铜管，它经过了三个星期五而在簿子上没有被录制。
jazz 意为“爵士乐”，指舞台里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一支小小的铜管。
jazz 意为“爵士乐”，指最远那架钢琴留给孩子们哼的那一支那一段，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
jazz 意为“自由、即兴”，指一件事里人人都听却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份自由就是那件事的全部。
jazz 意为“即兴”，指人人都听却无人提起的那样东西而不是那段曲调，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
jazz 意为“爵士乐”，指唱片里写到、被录下的的那一段，到 1983 年这一段成了唱片里的一行。
jazz 意为“演奏之事”，乐手七月写道，整件事的爵士乐之事是一处舞台和三个星期五的录制。
jazz 意为“爵士乐”，我记得的是唱片里录制过的那一段，1985 年录完了，至今仍被说成舞台里最安静的一段。
jazz 为抽象总称，母亲 1987 年说，爵士乐是唯一会因为被好好录制而变得更好的曲调。

那处舞台里每一种爵士乐旁边都有同一支小小的铜管。（jazz）
